text:
tom: Heads up — acme-inc (cust id acme-22) escalated: after we moved default to redwood/model-2.6 their schema validator fails on structured output. They get parsing errors ("Expecting value", "trailing comma") and items array becomes null. Request id: req_0a9f1c. Raw response from our logs pasted below.

sara: can you paste the exact curl and raw body?

tom: sure — reproducer curl and raw body from logs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n -d '{"model":"redwood/model-2.6","prompt":"Produce JSON: {\"items\": [{\"id\":1, ...}], \"meta\": {...}}","json_mode":"true"}'
```
Raw response (as stored):
```json
{"request_id":"req_0a9f1c","response":"{\"metadata\":{\"explanation\":\"thinking...\\\"},\"items\":null}","model":"redwood/model-2.6"}
```

sara: ugh looks like the assistant wrapped the JSON as a string in `response` and added a `metadata.explanation` node. That would break strict schema checks.

mike: Noted — this is from the 2.6 rollout where we set a new instruct-tuning checkpoint that adds internal "analysis" traces when `analysis_mode` is set. Bug: sometimes it emits the structured JSON as a string instead of raw JSON when fallback to analysis is triggered. Root cause tracked in ENG-7892.

jamie: Can we roll back the default model for hosted customers? deploy-bot: rollout status -> redwood/model-2.6: 25% traffic, redwood/model-2.5: 75%

mike: Short term mitigation: for customers needing strict JSON, set header X-Redwood-Model: redwood/model-2.5 or pin model param. Also we will add server-side sanitization to try to parse stringified JSON before returning to client. Patch in progress: PR #4123.

tom: Customer is blocking — they can't parse messages for workflow. I've created internal ticket SUP-4421 and shared a repro. Customer willing to accept pinning to 2.5 for now.

sara: Assigning SUP-4421 to eng-oncall. @mike can you take first pass? Also DM the customer steps to pin model param.

mike: Taking it. I'll push a hotfix to attempt auto-unwrapping of `response` string and strip `metadata` when `json_mode` is true. ETA 3 hours.

jamie: Noted, I'll update the status page and add incident note.

deploy-bot: incident created SUP-4421. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4421

tom: thanks. keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
